title: Fritz!Box · Home Network
description: Fritz!Box router metrics from otelcol-fritzbox, built with Business Charts.

panels.title: Home network, live
panels.description: Particle speed and size on the WAN link follow live download and upload throughput. Device links show connectivity, not per-device traffic.

panels.title: Live speed
panels.description: Current WAN throughput against the DSL sync rate.

panels.title: Live traffic pulse
panels.description: Last 15 minutes of WAN traffic. The rippling dot marks the newest sample.

panels.title: WAN throughput
panels.description: Download above the baseline, upload mirrored below. Drag the slider or scroll to zoom.

panels.title: DSL line capacity
panels.description: Current sync rate as a share of the attainable rate the line could sync at.

panels.title: WLAN clients by radio
panels.description: Band derived from the radio channel.

panels.title: Devices
panels.description: Known devices: online or offline, then how they connect. Click a ring to drill in.

panels.title: DSL line errors in range
panels.description: CRC, FEC and HEC errors counted over the selected time range.

panels.title: DSL signal-to-noise margin
panels.description: Below 6 dB the line is prone to resyncs.

panels.title: WAN utilization
panels.description: Download throughput as a share of the WAN link speed.
